en.meta_title: Pedodontics: Gentle & Compassionate Dental Care for Children
en.meta_description: Ensure a lifetime of good oral health for your child with our pedodontic services. We focus on gentle, fun dental care, including cleanings, fillings, and preventive treatments for milk teeth in a welcoming environment.
en.meta_keywords: pedodontics, children's dentistry, pediatric dentist, milk teeth treatment, baby teeth care, kids dental care, gentle dentistry

what_is.heading: What is Pedodontics? A Foundation for a Healthy Smile
paragraphs: Establishing a positive foundation for a lifetime of good oral health starts with excellent care for primary (baby) teeth. Our pedodontic services at LUNAI focus on providing gentle, compassionate, and fun dental care for children in a welcoming environment.

importance.heading: The Importance of Healthy Milk Teeth
paragraphs: The health of milk teeth is crucial. They play a vital role in proper chewing, speech development, and holding space for the permanent teeth to erupt correctly. Untreated decay in baby teeth can lead to pain, infection, and problems with the developing adult teeth.

our_services.heading: Our Children's Dental Services
paragraphs: Our milk teeth treatments include gentle cleanings, tooth-colored fillings, pulp therapy (pulpotomy), and crowns to protect weakened teeth. We strive to make every visit a positive experience to prevent dental anxiety and educate families on proper oral hygiene.
